title: Bathrooms and toilet rooms in R and I-1 occupancies.
officialText:
Bathrooms or toilet rooms in R or I-1 occupancies shall
be provided with natural ventilation in accordance with Section 1203.4.1.3, unless provided with exhaust ventilation in
accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code. Openings providing required natural ventilation shall be windows.
Exception: Openable skylights may be substituted for windows provided that the bathroom or toilet room is on the top
story.
